[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VII · Suits Relating to Tort
 Section: 82::Two years.
]


By executors, administrators or representatives under the Indian Fatal Accidents Act, 1855 (13 of 1855).
Period of limitationTwo years.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the death of the person killed.
